title: Whisper ASR Error Analysis
description: Whisper large-v3 performance on Hindi-Bengali code-mixed speech, measured against human-corrected reference transcripts

overall_metrics.note: WER not computable due to script mismatch (Whisper outputs Devanagari, corrections in Roman). Segment-level error rate used instead.

wrong_word.description: Whisper produced incorrect Hindi words for what was actually said

missing_bengali.description: Segments explicitly tagged as having Bengali that Whisper converted

hallucination.description: Whisper generated text not present in audio

bengali_detection.description: Whisper missed or converted 100% of Bengali words. All Bengali lexical items were either transliterated to Hindi equivalents or produced as garbled Devanagari.

gender_normalization.description: Whisper silently normalized non-standard gender agreement to standard Hindi forms, erasing the L1 transfer patterns this study measures.

conclusion: Whisper large-v3 is fundamentally unsuitable as a sole transcription tool for Hindi-Bengali code-mixed speech in sociolinguistic research. Its 83.3% segment error rate, 0% Bengali word preservation, and silent gender correction make human verification mandatory. The ASR system systematically erases the non-standard morphological patterns that are the primary object of study.
